Body.Content:
What and Why:

Microsoft is updating the Copilot experience in Viva Learning. Users will now be redirected from the existing Copilot experience in Viva Learning to Learning Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot. This provides a more unified and personalized learning experience and enables users to access learning assistance across Microsoft 365 experiences.

Rollout Schedule:

  • General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout began in late June 2026 and completes by late August 2026.
  • Available to all Viva Learning licensed users: August 15, 2026.

Impact on Your Organization:

Who is affected:

  • All Viva Learning licensed users.
  • Microsoft 365 administrators managing Viva Learning and Copilot experiences.

Platforms/Services:

  • Viva Learning
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot
  • Microsoft Teams
  • Learning Agent
  • Microsoft 365 Admin Center

What will happen:

  • Users selecting the Copilot button in Viva Learning will be redirected to Learning Agent.
  • The previous side-by-side Copilot experience in Viva Learning will no longer be available.
  • The Copilot button will remain visible to Viva Learning licensed users.
  • Users who have not previously installed Learning Agent will be prompted to add it.
  • Admins can deploy and manage Learning Agent through Microsoft 365 admin controls.

Action Required/Recommendations:

Action is recommended.

Checklist for administrators:

  • Review whether your organization intends to allow access to Learning Agent before rollout completion.
  • Verify that Learning Agent is permitted within your tenant and is not restricted by organizational policies.
  • Review Viva Feature Access Management settings if you want to restrict visibility of the Copilot button in Viva Learning.
  • Determine whether Learning Agent should be deployed to all users or specific Microsoft 365 groups. 
  • Update internal training materials and help desk documentation to reflect the new experience.
  • Communicate to users that the previous side-by-side Copilot experience in Viva Learning will be replaced by Learning Agent.
  • Review the deployment guidance in Set up Learning Agent before rollout.

Learn more:

  • Access the Learning Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
  • Set up Learning Agent | Microsoft Learn

Compliance Considerations:

ConsiderationExplanation
Does the change introduce or significantly modify AI/ML or agent capabilities that interact with or provide access to customer data?The existing Copilot experience in Viva Learning is being replaced by Learning Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, changing how users interact with AI-powered learning assistance and introducing an agent-based experience for learning-related questions.
Does the change provide end users any new way of interacting with generative AI?Users will access learning support through Learning Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot rather than the existing side-by-side Copilot experience in Viva Learning.
Does the change include an admin control and can it be controlled through Entra ID group membership?Administrators can manage Learning Agent deployment, control access, and target availability to specific Microsoft 365 groups through Microsoft 365 admin controls.
Does the change allow a user to enable and disable the feature themselves?Users can add Learning Agent from the Microsoft 365 Copilot agent store when the agent is made available to them by their organization.

Details.Name: Summary
Details.Value: The Viva Learning Copilot experience is transitioning to Learning Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, providing a unified, personalized learning experience. Rollout occurs from late June to August 2026 for all Viva Learning licensed users. Admins should review access, update materials, and manage deployment via Microsoft 365 controls.
